description: Ministry of City Planning & Water Supply - Order to acquire the land in Homapola, Pallepola D/S Division, Matale District for the construction purposes and 3 other acquires
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains multiple orders under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act approving the acquisition of specific immovable properties (land parcels) for water supply infrastructure projects. The content includes detailed descriptions of land boundaries, survey plans, locations, and claimants - all characteristic of land-related administrative matters. While a government minister is named, this is incidental to the core land acquisition purpose, and no detailed ministerial portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes are described.
